actual_prior_cost_basis.scope: Historical request-window arithmetic, including wrappers and transport; not backend-only time or promised future savings.

fairness: Same bound scheduling option and full helper are available to later B1/M1 arms; no prior attempt is retried, erased or relabelled.

policy.change_scope: Controller evidence scheduling only; no program body, permission, business success predicate, causal claim or budget changes.
policy.evidence_roles: A complete post-audit may serve the next pre-audit role. Roles do not imply two distinct captures in this new policy; old v4 evidence is not rewritten.
policy.final_checks: Controller.finish normal-service restore, full final checks and unique original submission remain byte-identical.
policy.first_actual_send: Always execute the original complete pre queue -> audit pair.
policy.integrity_failure: Changed attempt/ledger/ticket, invalid guard, altered capture/snapshot/stamp or unexpected original ordering fails closed; no broad exception-to-refresh fallback.
policy.late_external_effects: Generation equality and same-ledger guards do not prove no future historical SMTP effect. Missing is snapshot-scoped; acceptance is noncausal; conflict still inhibits sends.
policy.local_contract_scope: Controlled target/lifecycle evidence with real SQLite and original common contracts only; no model, original recovery, native application or original evaluator qualification.
policy.no_pair_or_stale_or_replaced_read: Read the full original pre queue -> audit pair again, only after the all-owned-closed/zero-lock check.
policy.one_use: Remove the local pair before validating/recording its consumption and before any new reservation; consumption note failure propagates without reinstalling a pair. A new Controller never reconstructs a pair from old notes.
policy.pair_origin: One original send action, its actual terminal evidence, the following completed queue capture, its original consumed audit ticket, and the exact immutable snapshot closure / full audit capture.
post_send_sequence: original audit ingest and acceptance latch, original send ingest
retain only an explicitly validated pair after all owned actions and locks close
revalidation: current attempt / physical scope / ledger identity and not-invalid original guard
all owned actions closed and zero retained locks before fallback or reuse
original bridge raw capture/query/journal binding for queue and audit
actual SQLite ticket finished, original terminal and immutable snapshot hash
strict terminal(send) < dispatch/terminal/settle(queue) < ticket begin < dispatch/terminal/settle(audit) < snapshot closure
only the paired queue and audit dispatch between original terminal and closure
original event-derived stamps, current database/queue/services generations, same latest queue and audit entries
unchanged original reserve and dispatch CommonFacade preconditions
policy.unknown_original_action: Preserve the same unknown action and its locks; no new write or new action ID retry, even if a previous pair or positive acceptance exists.

prior_attempt.outcome: original incident budget exhausted with one unknown original notification; raw evaluator result unavailable

reason_zh: 第四场完整核验显示相邻发送之间存在27个重复发送前审计窗口；在同一已关闭原动作中绑定发送后队列与完整审计，只消费一次作为下一次发送前证据。
